No checkerboard (painted or simulated), white background, gradients, shadows outside the bodies, antialiased magenta blending, matte halos, labels, text, guides, scenery, characters or stray marks. Paint SIX complete whole variants: V1 W140 maxD18 L24 R24; V2 W180 maxD18 L24 R24; V3 W190 maxD28 L24 R90; V4 W210 maxD28 L24 R90; V5 W200 maxD28 L24 R90; V6 W200 maxD27 L45 R24. Substantial coherent chunky body and long natural tapering ends, not thin sticks. D is maximum depth, not compulsory exact attained height.
Guide requests 2048x1152, roughly 4x native painted scale, two columns/three rows with generous perfectly magenta empty gutters, but actual dimensions/positions/scales will be measured from returned paint. Each whole sprite must fit by a SINGLE equal x/y scale; no anisotropic squeeze, stretching, cropping of body/ends, modular assembly, notches or masks. Fill all six guide limiting shapes with cohesive rock/snow design while remaining within their respective envelopes. Each complete sprite has empty space all around and no detached snow flecks. No labels anywhere. Source appearance, full snow tops, shape fit and native readability are separate gates, not guaranteed by this request.
